project_type: Python FastAPI + Jinja2 dashboard, Bloomberg-style multi-agent investment analysis system
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, pip install, Makefile available
test_framework: pytest with 442 tests in tests/ directory
build_command: pip install -e . && python -c 'from dashboard.app import app'
verification_instructions: 1) pip install -e '.[data,dev]' 2) python -m pytest tests/ -x -q 3) python -c 'from dashboard.app import app' 4) Check no import errors
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network, Python 3.11 available via pyenv. Do NOT modify any test files. Commit messages in Chinese. Push to main branch directly.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify test files. Use commit messages in Chinese. Each task gets its own commit. Python 3.9+ compatible. No external frontend frameworks (vanilla JS only).
key_patterns: FastAPI app in dashboard/app.py with Jinja2 templates in dashboard/templates/. CSS in dashboard/static/css/bloomberg.css. API endpoints follow /api/... pattern. Persona YAML files in personas/ and personas/custom/. Data layer in src/augur/data.py with multi-source provider chain. Report generation in src/augur/report.py.
directory_structure: root: pyproject.toml, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example | src/augur/: core Python package (data.py, report.py, registry.py, cli.py, api.py, personas/, datasources/) | dashboard/: FastAPI app (app.py, templates/, static/) | personas/: markdown persona definitions + custom/ yaml | tests/: 442 pytest tests | docs/: CHANGELOG, guides, images
